last.verdict: Moderna swung to a quarterly profit and raised its revenue outlook, but the cash boost is mostly borrowed money, and melanoma data now drives the story.

takeaways.label: Profit, higher outlook
takeaways.text: Third-quarter revenue rose 29% to $1.3 billion, mostly international COVID sales, and net income was $162 million. Full-year revenue growth is now seen at 15%–25%, up from up to 10%.

takeaways.label: Cash jump is borrowed
takeaways.text: Year-end cash is now seen at $8.1–8.3 billion, up from $4.7–5.2 billion. About $2.6 billion of that is net proceeds from convertible notes, a form of debt.

takeaways.label: Melanoma shot works
takeaways.text: Phase 3 data showed the melanoma cancer vaccine intismeran, given with Keytruda, cut the risk of recurrence or death by 42%. Regulatory filings and a launch are being prepared with Merck.

takeaways.label: Flu launch limited, norovirus stalled
takeaways.text: The FDA approved the flu shot mFLUSIVA in August, but only a limited U.S. launch is planned this season. The norovirus vaccine's path forward is unclear.

history.verdict: Norovirus vaccine setback outweighed a smaller-than-expected loss and lower costs.

reasons.label: Norovirus vaccine setback
reasons.text: Phase 3 norovirus vaccine missed early-success bar; more patients must be enrolled, delaying it.

reasons.label: Pipeline over numbers
reasons.text: Revenue is only $145M, so the stock trades on upcoming flu and melanoma news.

reasons.label: Cost cuts, cash runway
reasons.text: Spending outlook trimmed about $0.2B; year-end cash now seen at $4.7–5.2B.
